title: @uuidna/qpu — QPU worker: quantum processing unit as three readings (empty seat, BindingPoint width, hologram)
description: QPU (quantum processing unit) worker at https://qpu.uuidna.com. JSON readings of one machine: empty QPU seat, five-point BindingPoint width (CPU, GPU, RAM, CACHE, STORAGE), and sealed hologram bit-widths (foundation 0, debit 3, credit 6, pentagram 5, fold 7, octet 8, VE 14). Cloudflare Workers, TypeScript, Workers-safe, no Node builtins, no hardware dispatch. Package @uuidna/qpu. Same licence as uuidna (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Live: GET / /seat /width /hologram /.well-known/qpu.json.
references: Rouschev T. uuidna — content-addressed identity. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22256708. https://uuidna.com
BindingPoint — width is the smallest of CPU, GPU, RAM, CACHE, STORAGE. https://uuidna.com/publications/bindingpoint
method: Three constructor readings served as JSON from a Cloudflare Worker. Seat reads the empty QPU lane. Width names the BindingPoint pentagram CPU GPU RAM CACHE STORAGE. Hologram is sealed bit widths: foundation 0, debit 3, credit 6, pentagram 5, fold 7, octet 8, VE 14. No device is dispatched.
